history.evidence_id: DATA_MAP 2.2: ratings block 2016-present, aggregated 2017-present; dictionary CA0092.csv (46 fields, 3 tables inspected)

metric_lag.evidence_id: dictionary: vendor_published_at = when the source published to the feed; ca_receipt_date = when the file was received - both are delivery clocks

vintage.evidence_id: dictionary: ca_drop_partition identifies the vendor drop a record arrived in, including explicit full-backfill markers (e.g. Full-backfill-2022-12-31) vs dated drops - vintage identity is recorded per row

coverage.evidence_id: dictionary CA0092.csv inspected; per-record identity is point-in-time by design (ticker_on_event_date, cik_on_event_date, company_name_on_event_date, stock_exchange_on_event_date, MIC on event date)

unresolved_questions: BACKFILL TREATMENT (binding): rows arriving in Full-backfill-* partitions carry older event_dates but were knowable only at the drop date. Availability rule must be ca_receipt_date/vendor_published_at, never event_date. The backfill-marker set must be enumerated before features run.
COVERAGE: the delisting test and covered-vs-uncovered comparison (spec 6.3, 9.8) are not yet run.

INTERPRETATION: rating_gap, rating_roic, rating_fcf_yield and rating_price_to_ebv_ratio are vendor-computed composites; they are baseline/vendor features (DATA_MAP 2.2: 'not assumed novel alpha') and must beat cheap public style controls to be admitted (spec 4.3).
Aggregated series (2017-) and block series (2016-) may differ in construction; which series a feature uses must be declared per experiment.
